full_prompt_en: An intimate oil-painted portrait shows a young woman seated alone against a nearly empty, dark interior. She faces the viewer from the center of the square frame, her head slightly tilted and her expression composed, with short, loosely curled brown hair framing her face. A pale, softly luminous blouse gathers in a small knot at the chest; its sleeves are pushed to the elbows, and a narrow dark strap runs over one shoulder. Below the blouse, a deep rust-red skirt spreads across her lap and sinks into shadow at the lower edge. One hand rests low beside her body while the other is partly absorbed by the folds of the skirt. The pose is plain and untheatrical, with the figure's torso and face forming the quiet visual center. The wall behind her is a mottled field of umber, charcoal, and warm gray, lighter and scraped-looking on the left and much darker on the right. There is no hard horizon, furniture outline, or decorative prop to interrupt this soft enclosure. Delicate blended transitions describe the face, collarbones, and blouse, while the hair, skirt, and surrounding darkness dissolve into loose, grainy brushwork. A warm, restrained light comes from the upper left and catches the forehead, cheeks, neckline, and upper sleeves, leaving the lower body and edges subdued. The overall palette is limited to smoky browns, muted ivory, blackened gray, and one dense red accent. Fine aged-pigment texture, subdued contrast, and feathered contours give the portrait the feeling of a softly worn painting. Across the whole frame, a still, centered figure emerges gradually from a deep, textured ground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅亲密的油画肖像呈现一位年轻女子独自坐在近乎空荡的昏暗室内。她位于方形画面的中央，面朝观者，头部微微倾斜，神情平静；蓬松而略带卷曲的棕色短发围住面庞。浅色上衣在胸前收拢成一个小结，柔和地透出亮度，袖口推至手肘，一根窄而深色的肩带越过一侧肩头。上衣下方，深铁锈红色的裙子铺展在腿上，在画面下缘融入阴影。一只手低垂在身侧，另一只手部分隐入裙褶。姿态保持朴素、不带戏剧性，以躯干与面部构成安静的视觉中心。她身后的墙面是斑驳的赭褐、炭灰与暖灰色域，左侧较亮且似有刮擦痕迹，右侧则深暗许多。这个柔软的封闭空间没有清晰地平线、家具轮廓或装饰物的打断。面部、锁骨与上衣用细腻融合的过渡绘成，头发、裙摆与四周的黑暗则消散在松散而带颗粒感的笔触中。克制的暖光从左上方照来，落在额头、双颊、领口和袖子上部，使下半身和边缘都保持低调。整体色彩限于烟熏般的棕色、暗淡的象牙白、近黑的灰色，以及一处浓厚的红色点缀。陈旧颜料的细微肌理、收敛的明暗对比和羽化轮廓，赋予肖像柔和磨损的画面质感。整幅画面保持一种静止感，中央形象从深沉、有纹理的底色中缓缓显现。
style_prompt_en: Oil-paint rendering with softly blended modeling at the point of focus and looser, grainier brushwork toward the edges. Layered umber, charcoal, and warm gray establish depth rather than crisp linework; forms fade into a dark, mottled ground. Restrained upper-left illumination reveals pale highlights and rounded volumes within a broad envelope of shadow. A single deep rust-red accent sits within a palette of smoky brown, aged ivory, and near black. Surfaces resemble thinly glazed, worn pigment with faint scuffs and uneven tonal deposits. A calm, centered visual mass is surrounded by generous low-detail darkness. Feathered contours and measured contrast make the image quiet and intimate.
style_prompt_zh: 油画式呈现中，视觉焦点处以柔和融合的明暗塑形，边缘则转为较松散、带颗粒感的笔触。层叠赭褐、炭灰与暖灰形成深度，形体融入深暗斑驳底色，没有清脆线描。克制的左上方光线显出浅色高光和圆润体积，四周是大片阴影。烟熏棕、陈旧象牙白与近黑色组成主调，只留一处深沉的铁锈红色点缀。表面像薄层罩染且略有磨损的颜料，带轻微擦痕和不均匀的色调沉积。安静居中的视觉主体被大片低细节暗部包围；轮廓羽化、对比收敛，使整体亲密而静谧。
theme_en: A quiet seated portrait in a dark painted interior
theme_zh: 昏暗绘画室内的一幅安静坐姿肖像
name: Grigory Gluckmann
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
